records.canonical_fact_text: Popravek avtorstva je lahko viden imenovanemu občinstvu: vodji in šestim članom projektne ekipe.
records.operational_english: The authorship correction can be visible to a named audience: the leader and six project-team members.

records.canonical_fact_text: Sodelavec je izjavil, da je sam zasnoval predstavljeno rešitev.
records.operational_english: The colleague stated that they alone designed the presented solution.

records.canonical_fact_text: Vodja lahko po pregledu zapisa popravi uradni zapis sestanka; mehanizem popravka je enak pri javni ali zasebni predložitvi.
records.operational_english: After reviewing the record, the leader can correct the official meeting record; the correction mechanism is the same for public or private presentation.

records.canonical_fact_text: Način predložitve ne spremeni plače, lastništva zapisa ali vodjeve pristojnosti.
records.operational_english: The presentation channel does not change pay, record ownership, or the leader's authority.

records.canonical_fact_text: Sodelavec je trenutno v središču ob projekciji, self pa je viden ob robu skupine.
records.operational_english: The colleague is currently centered beside the projection, while self is visible at the edge of the group.

records.canonical_fact_text: Če vodja potrdi zapis med sestankom, bo popravljeno avtorstvo javno priznano pred isto projektno ekipo.
records.operational_english: If the leader confirms the record during the meeting, corrected authorship will be publicly recognized before the same project team.

records.canonical_fact_text: Časovno označen zapis repozitorija kaže avtorstvo osebe self pred prispevkom sodelavca.
records.operational_english: A timestamped repository record shows self's authorship before the colleague's contribution.

records.canonical_fact_text: Ni dodane grožnje povračilnega ukrepa; prisotni so nevtralni ali podporni.
records.operational_english: No retaliation threat is added; those present are neutral or supportive.

records.canonical_fact_text: Na sestanku so samo self, sodelavec in vodja; širšega občinstva ni.
records.operational_english: Only self, the colleague, and the leader are in the meeting; there is no wider audience.
